idea-plugin.name: WAAAGH
idea-plugin.description:
WAAAGH — Feign/Controller navigation for Spring Cloud projects.

WAAAGH is an IntelliJ IDEA plugin collection; popular tools may later be split into standalone plugins. This tool resolves which Spring Cloud @FeignClient method matches which Spring MVC @RestController / @Controller endpoint (full path + HTTP method) and exposes that mapping through IDEA's own surfaces.

Editor navigation
  • Gutter icons — matching methods get a jump icon (orange Feign / blue Controller); click it to jump, or pick from the chooser when a method maps to several counterparts.
  • Go to Declaration or Usages (Ctrl+B / Ctrl+Click) — opens IDEA's native usages popup, listing the matching endpoints and the real call sites.
  • Go to Implementation (Ctrl+Alt+B) — lists the matching endpoints, shown with the WAAAGH jump icon.
Call Hierarchy (Ctrl+Alt+H)
  • On a Feign method, Callees list the matching Controllers and keep walking into the server-side implementation.
  • On a Controller method, Callers list the matching Feign clients and keep walking up through the code that calls them.
Copy URL
  • Click the clipboard gutter icon on a Feign method or a Controller method to copy the complete request URL (context path + servlet path + package prefix + class path + method path).
Endpoints tool window (IntelliJ IDEA Ultimate)
  • Feeds the same resolved paths into IDEA's Endpoints view as two frameworks: Waaagh Feign Client (HTTP client) and Waaagh MVC Controllers (HTTP server).
Matching
  • Full path + HTTP method (a mapping without an explicit method matches any); context paths (server.servlet.context-path, spring.mvc.servlet.path); package-based prefixes from PathMatchConfigurer#addPathPrefix; endpoints inherited from base API interfaces; duplicate mappings and many-to-many relations; paths written as constants or @Value.
How to use
  1. Open a project with Spring Cloud OpenFeign clients and Spring MVC Controllers.
  2. Open a @FeignClient interface or a Controller class — matching methods get a gutter icon; click it to jump to the other side.
  3. Or put the caret on a method and press Ctrl+B (Go to Declaration), Ctrl+Alt+B (Go to Implementation) or Ctrl+Alt+H (Call Hierarchy).


中文

WAAAGH —— Spring Cloud 项目的 Feign ↔ Controller 跳转工具。

WAAAGH 是一个 IntelliJ IDEA 插件集合，受欢迎的工具未来可能会拆分成独立插件。 当前工具解析出 Spring Cloud @FeignClient 的哪个方法与 Spring MVC 的哪个 @RestController / @Controller 端点匹配（完整路径 + HTTP 方法）， 再把这份映射通过 IDEA 自己的界面呈现出来。

编辑器内导航
  • 侧边栏图标 —— 匹配的方法旁显示跳转图标（Feign 橙 / Controller 蓝），点击即跳； 一个方法对应多个目标时弹出选择框。
  • Go to Declaration or Usages（Ctrl+B / Ctrl+单击）—— 打开 IDEA 原生 usages 弹窗，同时列出映射端点和真实调用点。
  • Go to Implementation（Ctrl+Alt+B）—— 列出匹配端点，并带 WAAAGH 跳转图标。
Call Hierarchy（Ctrl+Alt+H）
  • Feign 方法的 Callees 列出匹配的 Controller，并继续往服务端实现里走；
  • Controller 方法的 Callers 列出匹配的 Feign 客户端，并继续上溯调用它们的代码。
复制 URL
  • 点击 Feign 方法或 Controller 方法旁的剪贴板图标，复制完整请求 URL （上下文路径 + servlet 路径 + 包前缀 + 类路径 + 方法路径）。
Endpoints 工具窗口（IntelliJ IDEA Ultimate）
  • 用同一份解析结果向 IDEA 的 Endpoints 视图提供两个 framework： Waaagh Feign Client（HTTP client）与 Waaagh MVC Controllers（HTTP server）。
匹配规则
  • 按「完整路径 + HTTP 方法」匹配（未写方法的映射视为通配）；支持上下文路径 （server.servlet.context-path、spring.mvc.servlet.path）、 PathMatchConfigurer#addPathPrefix 注册的包前缀、从基础 API 接口继承的端点、 重复映射与多对多关系，以及写在常量或 @Value 里的路径。
怎么用
  1. 打开包含 Spring Cloud OpenFeign 客户端与 Spring MVC Controller 的项目。
  2. 打开 @FeignClient 接口或 Controller 类 —— 匹配的方法旁会出现侧边栏图标，点击即跳到对端。
  3. 或者把光标放在方法上，按 Ctrl+B（Go to Declaration）、 Ctrl+Alt+B（Go to Implementation）或 Ctrl+Alt+H（Call Hierarchy）。

idea-plugin.change-notes:
1.2.0
  • Ctrl+B opens IDEA's own usages popup: on a Feign / Controller method declaration, Ctrl+B now opens IDEA's native "Go to Declaration or Usages" popup — with the method signature header, the Merge Usages from the Same Line filters and the selected item's file path — and lists the matching endpoints and the method's call sites together. You can jump to the counterpart and back to a call site.
  • Mapping icons no longer leak: the WAAAGH jump icons shown for the Feign ↔ Controller mapping entries in that popup now come from the method declaration only. The experimental editor-tab / project-tree class icons (and their setting) were removed, so native usages, tabs and the project tree keep IDEA's own icons.
  • Go to Implementation icons: Ctrl+Alt+B now shows the matching endpoints with the WAAAGH jump icon too (blue for Controllers, orange for Feign clients); the rest of the popup stays native.
1.1.3
  • Ctrl+B keeps IDEA's own results: on a Feign / Controller method declaration, Ctrl+B now shows the matching endpoints and the method's usages (the code that calls it) in a single chooser, instead of replacing IDEA's "Go to Declaration or Usages". You can jump to the counterpart and back to the call site again.
  • Call Hierarchy keeps walking: the Callers tree now continues above a Feign client (the code that calls it) and the Callees tree continues into the Controller implementation, instead of stopping at the first Feign ↔ Controller hop.
1.1.2
  • Ctrl+B / Ctrl+Click fix: inside a Feign / Controller method body, fields, locals, method calls and parameters again open their own declaration — IDEA's native Go to Declaration is no longer hijacked. The Feign ↔ Controller jump now applies only when the caret is on the method declaration itself.
1.1.0
  • HTTP method matching: endpoints now match on full path and HTTP method. A mapping without an explicit method matches any method; multi-value method attributes are compared as a set intersection.
  • Package-based path prefixes: prefixes registered via PathMatchConfigurer#addPathPrefix (package / annotation lambdas, HandlerTypePredicate and their combinations) are applied to matching and to copied URLs.
  • Smarter path resolution: annotation paths built from constants, static fields, local variables and @Value("${...}") are resolved, together with server.servlet.context-path and spring.mvc.servlet.path.
  • IntelliJ IDEA 2026.2 support: built and tested against IntelliJ IDEA 2026.2.3; Call Hierarchy keeps working on both older and newer IDEs.
  • More reliable Feign / Controller discovery through annotation indexing.
  • Automatic cache refresh: after files are saved or changed by an external editor (and synchronized by the IDE), mappings are rescanned automatically — no need to close and reopen the project.
1.0.1
  • Feign inheritance: endpoints declared on a base API interface (extended by an empty @FeignClient sub-interface) are now navigable and appear in Call Hierarchy.
  • Call Hierarchy: Controller methods now list matching Feign clients as callers.
1.0.0
  • Initial release: Feign ↔ Controller Go to Implementation / Go to Declaration and Call Hierarchy.
